verdict.rationale: iTerm2's GitHub README documents Smart Selection, which recognizes URLs and file paths (quad-click to select, Cmd-click to open, right-click for actions), and the features page describes the same recognition. A community user independently confirms that Semantic History lets you Cmd+Click a path to open it in your editor or associated app. Keyboard-driven selection exists via Copy Mode, but nothing shows that a keyboard selection can actually open the URL or path. Missing for 10: documented keyboard-only way to open a recognized URL or path, and in-depth docs on Semantic History configuration.
